Look at ALL sampled frames in the 0–4 second window. You are checking whether the entire opening is a single locked-off talking head with zero visual changes.

PASS immediately if ANY of the following are true across those frames:
- You see B-roll footage at any point (doesn't have to change — any B-roll at all is a pass)
- You see a split-screen, overlay graphic, text animation, or product insert
- You see a cut to a different shot or scene (even from one B-roll to another B-roll)
- The shot angle, background, or subject changes at any timestamp between 0–4 s

FAIL only if ALL of the following are true:
- Every frame from 0–4 s shows the same person talking directly to camera
- The camera angle, background, and framing do not change at all
- There is no B-roll, no graphic overlay, no split-screen, no insert shot of any kind

If in doubt, pass. This rule only catches a completely static, single-shot talking head with zero visual changes in the first four seconds.","severity":"polish","fixMessage":"First 4 seconds are pure talking head with nothing changing — drop in some B-roll, an overlay, or a product shot to break it up.","active":true,"archived":false,"source":{"origin":"manual"},"createdAt":1791343864371,"updatedAt":1791343864371},{"id":"1b779d4f-fae5-4220-baa8-b42c76f28428","kind":"vision","scope":"global","name":"CTA missing","what":"First check the briefing: if it explicitly states that no CTA is needed or wanted, pass this rule immediately. In both cases, check whether a clear call to action is visible — this means text or a visual element that tells the viewer what to do next, such as a website URL, a discount code, 'Shop now', 'Link in bio', 'Swipe up', a phone number, or a similar directive. If no call to action is found, this is a fail. If a CTA is present, pass.","severity":"blocker","fixMessage":"No CTA anywhere — the viewer watches and then... nothing. A black frame with text or a title card on it is fine — pass those. Only flag frames that are entirely empty with nothing on them. If one or more blank frames are found, this is a fail. Look at the image for signs of low quality: blurriness, pixelation, compression artifacts, or a resolution that looks too low for an ad (e.g. the image looks grainy or jagged at normal viewing size). If the image is noticeably blurry, pixelated, or low-resolution, this is a fail. If the image looks sharp and clean, pass.","severity":"polish","fixMessage":"Image looks blurry or pixelated — re-export at a higher resolution or find a sharper source file.","active":true,"archived":false,"source":{"origin":"manual"},"createdAt":1791343864372,"updatedAt":1791343864372},{"id":"1e648757-52c6-47e0-98f3-893792630b23","kind":"vision","scope":"global","name":"AI talking head tells","what":"VIDEO ONLY — skip immediately if mediaType is 'image'.

STEP 1 — ANIMATION CHECK (do this before anything else):
Look at the faces and characters in the video. Check for ANY of these visual markers of 3D animation or non-live-action content:
- Skin that looks like a rendered 3D surface: overly smooth, plastic-like, or with a visible mesh/texture overlay
- Eyes that are larger than realistic human proportions, or stylised/drawn-looking
- Facial features with exaggerated cartoon proportions (oversized jaw, nose, ears, or forehead)
- Hair rendered as a solid mass or stylised shape rather than individual strands
- Lighting that looks like a 3D render: perfectly even, unrealistically clean, or with visible render glow
- Background that is clearly a 3D rendered environment, illustrated, or painted — not real footage
- Body proportions that are exaggerated or idealised beyond what a real human would have
- ANY visual quality that makes this look like it was made in a 3D software (Pixar, DreamWorks, CGI, clay, stop-motion, cel animation, illustrated, etc.)

If ANY of those markers are present → STOP. This is animated content. Pass this rule immediately. Do not proceed.

STEP 2 — Only proceed if you are certain this is a real human being filmed with a real camera (live-action UGC, selfie video, talking head recorded on a phone or camera).

STEP 3 — Now check for AI talking-head tells across frames showing the face:
- Unnatural or absent blinking (eyes stay open too long, or blink robotically)
- Lip movements that don't match the audio rhythm
- Overly smooth skin with no pores, no micro-texture, no natural variation
- Hair that looks like a solid shape with no individual strands
- Stiff or very limited facial muscle movement around eyes and cheeks
- Fixed, glassy gaze with no natural micro eye-movements

FAIL only if you are certain this is a live-action human AND two or more of those tells are present.
If in doubt about whether this is real vs. animated — pass. This rule is only for live-action UGC with a real person.","severity":"blocker","fixMessage":"This talking head has AI tells — unnatural blinking, stiff expression, or plastic skin. If it's an AI avatar, use a higher-quality model or a different avatar. If it's supposed to be real UGC, the footage may have been AI-upscaled or altered.","active":true,"archived":false,"source":{"origin":"manual"},"createdAt":1791343864372,"updatedAt":1791343864372},{"id":"527f546b-3e52-43c5-a2b7-688d882a1207","kind":"vision","scope":"global","name":"Text not legible","what":"STATIC IMAGE ONLY — skip this rule immediately if mediaType is 'video'. Look at every piece of text in the image. FAIL if ANY of the following are true: text colour and background colour are so similar that the text blends in (e.g. white text on light grey, dark text on dark background — you have to squint to read it); text is so small it would be unreadable on a phone screen held at arm's length; text overlaps with a busy part of the image so it cannot be distinguished. PASS if all text is clearly readable against its background at a glance. If in doubt, pass.","severity":"polish","fixMessage":"Some text is hard to read at a glance — bump up the size, increase the contrast, or give it more breathing room.","active":true,"archived":false,"source":{"origin":"manual"},"createdAt":1791343864372,"updatedAt":1791343864372},{"id":"38e0cf54-f6a2-4561-a04e-8f01a488f278","kind":"checklist","scope":"global","name":"Safe zone check","what":"All captions, CTAs, and key text are fully inside the safe zone — nothing important sits in the orange overlay areas (top, bottom, or sides).","severity":"polish","fixMessage":"Move all captions, CTAs, and key text inside the safe zone — nothing important should sit in the orange overlay areas at the top, bottom, or sides.","active":true,"archived":false,"source":{"origin":"manual"},"createdAt":1791343864372,"updatedAt":1791343864372}]
